title: Choose the new world for KoLearn
question: Pastel and fun Korean, light and airy. The roll assigned Saekdong Sleeve. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Saekdong Sleeve
options.lineage: 색동 rainbow-striped hanbok sleeves, in sugar pastels
options.thesis: Every study day weaves one more pastel stripe into your sleeve, and each tool owns a stripe color.
options.viewport: Phone Today: a woven stripe band for the streak, big rounded Hangul headline, tap-to-reveal meaning chip, one dominant Continue button, native tab bar tinted per tool.
options.risk: Stripes turn into wallpaper if they do not carry real state like streak and active tool.

raised.raise: The saturated action color appears only on things you can press; stripes are never tappable.
Flat unmodulated color fields with no gradients or shadows; overshoot-and-settle motion at 0.4s.

options.label: Four-Cut Photobooth
options.lineage: 인생네컷 photobooth strips with pastel frames
options.thesis: Each lesson is a four-cut strip: word, sentence, meaning, you.
options.viewport: Phone Today: today's article as a vertical four-frame strip on a pastel backdrop.
options.risk: Familiar K-pop idea; frames can crowd Hangul text.

options.label: Warm Consumer App
options.thesis: Soft white cards on a warm ground, one bright color only where you can act.
options.viewport: Single column of friendly cards with a bottom bar.
options.case: Wins on clarity and reads as a real product; loses on audience since it has no Korean identity.

options.label: Garden Guide Map
options.thesis: Each tool is a swelling lobe of flat pastel with capsule controls.
options.viewport: One big lobe holds today's article, capsule buttons in pastel.
options.case: Holds the fun pastel feel; loses on clarity because organic lobes fight a reading layout.
options.risk: Lobes crowd Hangul text and can break native list conventions.

options.label: Vertical Feed
options.case: Loses both axes: dark, media-first and wrong for careful reading.
options.kept: One item owns the screen at a time.

options.label: Labanotation Score
options.case: Loses both axes: black-and-white notation is neither pastel nor Korean.
options.kept: Time encoded on one clear axis.

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.case: Loses both axes: cream and serif plates are quiet, not fun or Korean.
options.kept: Fixed scale so stages compare cleanly.

options.label: Variable Specimen
options.case: Loses both axes: austere ink-on-white, a type toy not a learning app.
options.kept: Hangul at monumental scale against tiny labels.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean pastel language-learning app, played straight.
canonCard.viewport: Greeting, streak, lesson cards, native tab bar.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other language apps by design.
